script.title: SIX EGGS AND A RUNNER
script.scene_zh: 超市停車場 · 幫忙提物
script.story_hook: A paper bag splits. A stranger reacts.
script.intro_zh: 紙袋裂開了，一個陌生人立刻動手幫忙。
script.welcome_en: Today a stranger offers help in a parking lot. Listen for kind English!
script.welcome_zh: 今天看陌生人在停車場熱心幫忙。注意聽體貼的英文！
script.outro: That's how eggs, lemons, and thanks make a new friend. Great work!
script.outro_zh: 雞蛋、檸檬和道謝就這樣交到了新朋友。表現很棒！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the offering-help phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸幫忙與道謝常用句。
script.char_a_description: a stout white woman in her late sixties with a curly gray bob and cat-eye glasses, wearing a lavender quilted jacket, dark navy trousers, a long pearl necklace, and thick-soled walking shoes
script.char_b_description: a lanky Latino teenager in his mid teens with shaggy dark brown hair, wearing an oversized navy basketball jersey, gray gym shorts despite the cold, tall white socks, and scuffed high-top sneakers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh dear. Oh no no no.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ dɪr oʊ noʊ noʊ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，天哪。不會吧不會吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ma'am? You okay? That bag just split.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæm ju oˈkeɪ ðæt bʌɡ dʒʌst splɪt/
dialogue.zh: 奶奶，您沒事吧？那個紙袋剛剛裂開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The eggs. The eggs got away from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛɡz ði ɛɡz ɡɑt əˈweɪ fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 是雞蛋，雞蛋從我手裡逃走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll chase 'em. Two doors down. Stay put.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tʃeɪz əm tu dɔrz daʊn steɪ pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我幫您追，滾到兩個車位那邊了。您站著別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I've got this, dear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪv ɡɑt ðɪs dɪr/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我自己可以，孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One's rolling toward the street. Moving now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌnz ˈroʊlɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə strit ˈmuvɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有一顆正往馬路滾！我去了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! Okay, thank you, young man!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ oˈkeɪ θæŋk ju jʌŋ mæn/
dialogue.zh: 噢！好，謝謝你，小夥子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got three! Where are the rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt θri ʍɛr ɑr ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 抓到三顆！剩下的在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under that car... and near the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðæt kɑr ænd nɪr ðə kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 在那輛車下面……還有購物車旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Operation egg rescue, going live.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɑpəˈreɪʃən ɛɡ ˈrɛskju ˈɡoʊɪŋ laɪv/
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋救援行動，正式展開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're silly. Come back here, careful!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ˈsɪli kʌm bæk hɪr ˈkɛrfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 您真風趣。回到這邊來，小心車子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All six, intact. Mostly intact.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɪks ɪnˈtækt ˈmoʊstli ɪnˈtækt/
dialogue.zh: 六顆全數歸隊。大概算是完好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bless you. My grandson never helps out.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɛs ju maɪ ˈɡrænˌsʌn ˈnɛvɚ hɛlps aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 真是麻煩你了。我孫子從不幫我提東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's got time. I've got legs. Trade you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz ɡɑt taɪm aɪv ɡɑt lɛɡz treɪd ju/
dialogue.zh: 他有時間，我有腿。咱倆交換吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Edith. Yes, I saw your name tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ ˈidɪθ jɛs aɪ sɔ jʊr neɪm tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我叫伊蒂絲。對，我看到你的名牌了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spirit! Now, is the car far?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈspɪrɪt naʊ ɪz ðə kɑr fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這才像話！對了，您的車停得遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row nine. But truly, the bags can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ naɪn bʌt ˈtruːli ðə bæɡz kæn weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 第九排。但說真的，袋子可以等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These two look about to quit on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz tu lʊk əˈbaʊt tə kwɪt ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 這兩大袋，眼看就要跟您說再見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They did their best. They gave me juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ dɪd ðɛr bɛst ðeɪ ɡeɪv mi dʒus/
dialogue.zh: 它們已經很努力了，只是讓我一身果汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! New bags live in my cart, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ nu bæɡz lɪv ɪn maɪ kɑrt mæm/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我購物車裡隨時有新袋子，奶奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're prepared. Are you a scout?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz prɪˈpɛrd ɑr ju ə skaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 真週到。你是童軍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope. Just bad at leaving stores early.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst bæd æt ˈlivɪŋ stɔrz ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 不是，我只是很不擅長早點離開商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear that. Forty years of overbuying.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ðæt ˈfɔrti jɪrz ʌv ˈoʊvɚˌbaɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 深有同感。我亂買四十年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, overbuying? Look inside this cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈoʊvɚˌbaɪɪŋ lʊk ˈɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，亂買？您看看我這臺車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lemons called to me. They always do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛmənz kɔld tə mi ðeɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz du/
dialogue.zh: 那些檸檬在呼喚我。牠們每次都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Respect. My mom's the same about cheese.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈspɛkt maɪ mɑmz ðə seɪm əˈbaʊt tʃiz/
dialogue.zh: 佩服。我媽對起司也是這個模樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, take two lemons. No arguments.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr teɪk tu ˈlɛmənz noʊ ˈɑrɡjumənts/
dialogue.zh: 來，拿兩顆檸檬去。不許推辭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free lemons? What did I do today?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈlɛmənz wʌt dɪd aɪ du təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 白送的檸檬？我今天究竟做了什麼好事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved six eggs and my dignity. Priceless.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd sɪks ɛɡz ænd maɪ ˈdɪɡnəti ˈprisˌlɛs/
dialogue.zh: 救了六顆蛋，也救了我的尊嚴。這無價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row nine, you said? Let's walk slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ naɪn ju sɛd lɛts wɔk sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 第九排是吧？我們慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm right behind you. Watch that last bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ju wɑtʃ ðæt læst bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我就在你後面。注意最後那袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trunk's open. Done. You are welcome, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌŋks ˈoʊpən dʌn ju ɑr ˈwɛlkəm mæm/
dialogue.zh: 後車廂開好了。搞定。不客氣，奶奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been a huge help. Really.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv bɪn ə hjuːd hɛlp ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 你真的幫了我大忙。說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's no trouble. I've got two arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts noʊ ˈtrʌbəl aɪv ɡɑt tu ɑrmz/
dialogue.zh: 不費事啦，我兩隻手臂都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, thank you. Wait one second here.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl θæŋk ju weɪt wʌn ˈsɛkənd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 還是要謝你。在這裡等我一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. What's up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊr θɪŋ wʌts ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cookie bag — take two. Say cheese.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkʊki bæɡ teɪk tu seɪ tʃiz/
dialogue.zh: 這袋餅乾，拿兩包去。說起司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ma'am, this is the best job ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæm ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst dʒɑb ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 奶奶，這是我做過最棒的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell your mom thanks for the bag trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl jʊr mɑm θæŋks fɚ ðə bæɡ trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 替我謝謝你媽媽，教你隨身帶備用袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will. She raised me right, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃi reɪzd mi raɪt ˈmoʊstli/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。我媽把我教得很好，大概。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly? What's the other part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli wʌts ði ˈʌðɚ pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 大概？那小部分呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was sent for milk. I forgot the milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz sɛnt fɚ mɪlk aɪ fərˈɡɑt ðə mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 我媽派我買牛奶，結果我忘了拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. The classic teen error.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə ˈklæsɪk tin ˈɛrɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，這是少年定番失誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll hide my charger for a whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːl haɪd maɪ ˈtʃɑrdʒɚ fɚ ə hoʊl wik/
dialogue.zh: 她肯定會把我的充電器藏一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here — take the lemons home as backup.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr teɪk ðə ˈlɛmənz hoʊm æz ˈbækˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 來，把檸檬帶回家，當成你的援軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're magic. Real live magic, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ˈmædʒɪk rɪl laɪv ˈmædʒɪk mæm/
dialogue.zh: 您會魔法吧。真正的魔法，奶奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go get your milk, young man. Two aisles back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ɡɛt jʊr mɪlk jʌŋ mæn tu ˈaɪəlz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 快去拿你的牛奶，小夥子。往回走兩排就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rescued twice before I even leave!
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈskjuːd twaɪs bɪˈfɔr aɪ ˈivən liv/
dialogue.zh: 我還沒離店，已經獲救兩回了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drive safe... oh wait, you walk home.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv seɪf oʊ weɪt ju wɔk hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 開車小心……噢不對，你是走路回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got my legs, remember? Trade still stands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt maɪ lɛɡz rɪˈmɛmbɚ treɪd stɪl stændz/
dialogue.zh: 記得嗎，我有腿。交易還算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll ask for the eggs only.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl æsk fɚ ði ɛɡz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 下次我就只拜託你照顧雞蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. No more egg escapes on my watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil noʊ mɔr ɛɡ ɪˈskeɪps ɑn maɪ wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。有我在，雞蛋不會再逃跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a good kid. Who's your mom?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ə ɡʊd kɪd huz jʊr mɑm/
dialogue.zh: 你是個好孩子。你媽媽是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rosa, produce section. She helps everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊzə proʊˈdus ˈsɛkʃən ʃi hɛlps ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 羅莎，生鮮區。她永遠在幫人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell Rosa that Edith owes her one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ˈroʊzə ðæt ˈidɪθ oʊz hɜr wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 跟羅莎說，伊蒂絲也欠她一個人情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll deny it, then hug you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːl dɪˈnaɪ ɪt ðɛn hʌɡ ju/
dialogue.zh: 她肯定嘴上說不用，然後抱您一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds like family. Go on, shoo.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz laɪk ˈfæməli ɡɑʊ ɑn ʃu/
dialogue.zh: 這就像家人一樣。去吧，快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Edith! Come back Saturday, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈidɪθ kʌm bæk ˈsætɚˌdeɪ oˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，伊蒂絲！週六還會來吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every Saturday, ten sharp. You've got a deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈsætɚˌdeɪ tɛn ʃɑrp jʊv ɡɑt ə dil/
dialogue.zh: 每週六，十點整。說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best errand ever. See you Saturday!
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst ˈɛrənd ˈɛvɚ si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是史上最棒的跑腿。週六見！

script.youtube_description:
雞蛋從裂開的紙袋滾向馬路，陌生人該不該開口幫忙？
這一集是60句完整的停車場對話：主動伸手、客氣婉拒、再次道謝、聊到彼此家人，暖心又實用。

你會學到：
・ offering help politely（有禮地提議幫忙）
・ refusing kindly and accepting gracefully（婉拒與接受的好看說法）
・ warm small talk with strangers（跟陌生人暖心閒聊）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，讓你在國外也能熱心又得體！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
Six eggs are rolling toward the street and a stranger is watching. What happens next?
This episode is one full 60-line exchange: offering help, politely declining, insisting kindly, and chatting on the walk to the car.

You will hear:
・ how to offer help without scaring anyone
・ graceful declining and warm accepting
・ small talk that turns into a Saturday tradition

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English with heart!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
紙袋裂開，雞蛋朝著馬路滾過去，在國外的你會開口嗎？
陌生人要幫忙，怎麼婉拒才不失禮？
這一集帶大家走進超市停車場，從追雞蛋到搬上後車廂，一句一句都是溫度。

你會聽到：
🥚「I'll chase 'em. Two doors down. Stay put。」幫忙時的第一句
🙅「Honestly, I've got this, dear。」客氣婉拒的說法
🤝「It's no trouble. I've got two arms。」堅持幫忙的溫暖回應
🍋「Here, take two lemons. No arguments。」道謝之後的體貼回禮

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60句停車場對話，一句一句慢速重複，讓句子自然進到嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你出門跑腿，總有人願意幫你追一顆蛋。
script.thumbnail_action: diving to catch a rolling egg
